newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt favours U.S. troops in Hebron.
newsitem.headline: Egypt favours U.S. troops in Hebron.

text.p: Egypt supports a Palestinian proposal to deploy U.S. troops in the West Bank town of Hebron, a senior Egyptian diplomat said on Wednesday.
Israel and the United States have already dismissed the proposal, announced by Arafat on Tuesday.

"Cairo supports the Palestinian proposal, which is a step on the road to reaching an agreement on the issues pending between the Israeli and Palestinian sides on Hebron," said the diplomat, who asked not to be identified.
U.S. Defence Secretary William Perry said on Tuesday that Arafat's proposal was not being considered.
"This has been proposed before and it is not under active consideration," he said before a meeting with Israeli Defence Minister Yitzhak Mordechai.

David Bar-Illan, media adviser to Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, said of the proposal: "(It) may actually cause the deaths of American soldiers in this area and I doubt very much whether bringing home American troops to America in body bags is going to...further...the peace process".
